svg.title: Driving instructor — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as driving instructor, wearing a collared shirt. Visible work cue: Steering wheel with three separated spokes above a route-instruction card. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: short curls, a softly squared face and round glasses.
